_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (see mergeManifestFragments in main.js). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu (ADR-037); this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId (groups dissolve into the target, leaves move under it). sections: menu-entry id -> section name (assigns a top-level leaf to a navigation section). removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links and e2e specs. settingsSection: top-level config/admin/integration ids lifted into Nextcloud's settings foldout (NcAppNavigationSettings gear, outside the scrollable nav) — see applySettingsSection in main.js; operational catalog/report/dashboard items stay in the main nav. Lives outside manifest.json because the app-manifest-v2 schema has additionalProperties:false at the root.

_settingsSectionNote: SettingsMenu (the app's own admin/config page: registers, sources, integration + import configuration via SoftwareCatalogSettingsPage) is the only genuine config/admin entry and is promoted into the NC settings foldout (the bottom-left gear, OUTSIDE the scrollable nav) by applySettingsSection in main.js. Operational catalog pages stay top-level: Dashboard, Contracts, Standards, Reviews, Module versions, Portfolio roadmap. Komplianties (Compliance) and ComplianceMatrix (Compliance matrix) are operational catalog reporting and stay top-level here — the consolidated 'Reports & Compliance' hub is a SEPARATE later wave and is intentionally NOT built in this change. Documentation and FeaturesRoadmapMenu carry section:'footer' in the manifest and stay where they are.
